sw_walker.text: I dipped my boots at St Bees on Monday. I am carrying a pebble in my pocket. It has become my best friend, and my lowest back pain.
Wainwright said, make up your own route if you like. Many do. Nobody gets a medal, but the B&B owners are very kind.

sw_shepherd.text: These meadows are cut late, after the flowers have gone to seed. Some of them have not been ploughed or sprayed in centuries.
Dozens of different flowers in a field, easy. My granddad could name every one. I can name about nine. The rest I call 'that blue one'.

sw_miner.text: Gunnerside Gill was one of the richest lead mines in the dale. They built the hushes: dammed a beck, let the water go all at once, and the whole hillside washed away to show the ore.
Brutal, but clever. They called it hushing.

sw_ranger.text: Mind the becks after rain. They come up fast, and they take hats.
